item.title: 11-year-old seriously injured after crashing e-motorcycle in Scripps Ranch
item.description: An 11-year-old child was seriously injured after crashing an electric motorcycle at Jerabek Park in Scripps Ranch, and the incident is still under investigation.

item.title: Read President Trump’s complete statement on Iran
item.description: Trump gave his remarks during an 8-minute video posted on his Truth Social platform.

item.title: State and local lawmakers respond to U.S.-Israeli attack on Iran
item.description: San Diego and state lawmakers have expressed their concerns over President Trump's decision to launch a large-scale military strike against Iran without prior congressional approval, with some questioning the president's authority to do so.

item.title: SDPD heighten vigilance amid Iran tensions, says no credible threats to San Diego
item.description: The San Diego Police Department is closely monitoring events in Iran and the Middle East, while increasing awareness around religious and cultural sites locally, and urging the public to stay alert and report any suspicious activity.

item.title: 'Open House' for Veterans held at Miramar National Cemetery
item.description: Veterans and their families gathered at Miramar National Cemetery for an open house hosted by the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs to learn about the benefits and services available to them, and to dedicate a new amphitheater for memorial services.

item.title: E-Bike rider suffers several fractures after colliding with Dodge Charger in Southcrest
item.description: A 34-year-old man suffered serious injuries after the e-bike he was riding crashed into a Dodge Charger on Saturday morning in Southcrest, and was transported to a local hospital for treatment.

item.title: San Diego-based aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln involved in Iran attack
item.description: The USS Abraham Lincoln, homeported in San Diego, played a key role in a coordinated US-Israeli operation against Iran's nuclear program, which included aerial and naval strikes targeting Iranian military infrastructure.

item.title: Crews knock down Mission Valley apartment fire, multiple condos damaged
item.description: Fire crews knocked down an apartment fire in the 6700 block of Friars Rd. on Saturday evening, with multiple condos damaged in the blaze and two people examined for smoke inhalation.

item.title: Iran’s supreme leader killed in major attack by US and Israel
item.description: DUBAI, United Arab Emirates (AP) — Iranian Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei was killed in a major attack by Israel and the United States, Iranian state media confirmed early Sunday, throwing the future of the Islamic Republic into doubt and raising the risk of regional instability. item.title: San Diego protests organized at Waterfront Park and Clairemont after strike on Iran
item.description: Protests are expected to take place throughout San Diego County following the US and Israel's launch of strikes on Iran, with both pro and anti-Iran demonstrators expected to participate.
